sonora_ca.name: Sonora
sonora_ca.obs_note: Sonora has no NWS observing station. The readings come from the Green Spring fire-weather station, 12 miles away and about 700 ft lower.

alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 13 at 11:54AM PST until November 13 at 7:00PM PST by NWS Sacramento CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...Portions of the northern San Joaquin Valley into the
Foothills.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM PST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects.Tree limbs
could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strongest winds expected this afternoon and
evening.

alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 13 at 10:43AM PST until November 13 at 10:00PM PST by NWS Reno NV
alerts.description:
* CHANGES...None.

* WHAT...South to southwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 55
mph. Wind prone areas along Highway 395 and Interstate 580 may see
gusts up to 65 mph.

* WHERE...In California, Lassen-Eastern Plumas-Eastern Sierra
Counties. In Nevada, Greater Reno-Carson City-Minden Area.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM PST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result. Gusty
winds may also cause blowing dust downwind of desert sinks,
reducing visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds may knock down burned trees in the Davis
Fire burn area.

alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 13 at 10:31AM PST until November 14 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...Death Valley National Park and Western Mojave Desert.

* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 10 AM PST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
